transcript.text: Top-line = SUM(amount) over completed orders, no discount subtracted, for calendar year 2025.

args.sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cents, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM memory.bench.orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
